command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Wait-Process -Id 5044 -ErrorAction Stop
& 'C:\Users\ethan\AppData\Local\hermes\node\node.exe' --max-old-space-size=256 research/reports/move-latency-zero-reset-2026-10-10/benchmark.mjs --out runs/move-latency-zero-reset-v1 --cpu-duty 0.5 *> research/reports/move-latency-zero-reset-2026-10-10/benchmark-console.txt

& npm.cmd test *> research/reports/move-latency-zero-reset-2026-10-10/full-regression-after-live-run.txt

[pscustomobject]@{ completedAt=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); benchmarkExitCode=$benchmarkExitCode; regressionExitCode=$regressionExitCode } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 research/reports/move-latency-zero-reset-2026-10-10/queued-checks-result.json
